clue.text: Loathed new fashions, as slovenly

indicators.note: to fashion is to shape or make, so the letters of the two words are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: Someone who hates new fashions and dresses carelessly as a result.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fashions' looks like a plural noun, but it is a verb telling you to rework LOATHED and NEW.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: being shabby and run-down in appearance, like shoes worn through at the back, is slovenly.

clue.text: Timber transaction

definitions.meaning: pine or fir wood sawn into planks

explanation.surface: A sale of wood.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: softwood planks, and a bargain struck between parties.

clue.text: Sees sense, possibly, within reason

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other, as the clue says the rearranged word sits within

parts.note: your wits are your reason or good sense

indicators.note: possibly signals that the word sense may be rearranged into another order

explanation.surface: Someone finally coming round to a sensible view, within the bounds of reason.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sees' looks like part of the surface phrase 'sees sense', but it is the definition, used as a verb meaning observes.
explanation.definitionFit: To see an event happen is to be present as an observer of it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: About time to go round — OK?

indicators.note: the word for time is to encircle the word for about, as the clue says it goes round it

parts.note: an age is a long period of time
re is Latin-derived for about or concerning

explanation.surface: A query asking whether it is fine to go round once more after a while.
explanation.definitionFit: To OK something, as a verb, is to consent or give approval to it.

clue.text: Tabitha abandoned natural home

indicators.note: abandoned suggests the name has been let loose and its letters run wild into a new order

explanation.surface: A woman named Tabitha has left her home in the wild.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the environment where an animal or plant normally lives and thrives.

clue.text: Arrived with tails in the air?

definitions.meaning: came finally to be somewhere, finished up
a whimsical second sense: having the ends pointing upwards

explanation.surface: Something landed with its tail raised.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to finish somewhere is to arrive; read literally, the words describe ends turned upwards.

clue.text: Married expert joined staff

parts.note: an ace is someone highly skilled

explanation.surface: A wedded specialist has taken up a post with the employees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'staff' looks like employees, but it is a ceremonial rod.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a ceremonial club or rod carried as a symbol of authority is a kind of staff.

clue.text: Winning article on school principal

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
the head is the teacher in charge of a school

explanation.surface: A news piece about a headteacher who is winning.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: being in the lead in a contest means you are winning at that point.

clue.text: More mature rock'n'roll singer that gets into wine

parts.note: elder means older
Chuck Berry, the American rock'n'roll pioneer

explanation.surface: An ageing rock star who has taken to drink.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition describes the fruit as something that goes into homemade wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the small dark fruit of the elder tree is a traditional ingredient of country wine.

clue.text: False credit note accepted by football team

indicators.note: one piece is taken in by the other, so it goes inside

parts.note: Spurs is the nickname of Tottenham Hotspur, a London football club
an IOU is a written promise to pay a debt

explanation.surface: A dodgy debt note handed to a football club.
explanation.walkthrough: SPURS is Tottenham Hotspur, a London football club.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something not genuine or authentic is counterfeit or bogus.

clue.text: Post back with little hesitation

parts.note: aft means at the back of a ship
er is the small sound made when hesitating

explanation.surface: Sending a reply by mail after a brief pause.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Post' looks like mail, but it is the Latin prefix meaning later.
explanation.definitionFit: Post- as in postwar is a prefix meaning following in time, a later point.

clue.text: Blanket coverage

parts.note: reads as total media reporting, but literally a cover laid over the blankets of a bed

explanation.surface: Reporting that covers everything.
explanation.definitionFit: Cryptic: a decorative cover thrown over the blankets on a bed.

clue.text: Inferior article press chief turned down

parts.note: a reject is a substandard item from a factory
ED is short for editor, the chief at a newspaper

explanation.surface: A newspaper editor refusing a poor piece of writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'article' looks like a newspaper piece, but it means a manufactured item.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something refused or declined has been rebuffed.

clue.text: It locates aircraft coming or going

indicators.note: the word reads the same whichever way you travel through it, forwards or backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A system that tracks planes arriving and departing.
explanation.definitionFit: Function: a system using radio echoes to detect planes and ships.

clue.text: Did so well, a resitting is not permitted

indicators.note: a resit is retaking an exam, here sitting the letters down again in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A student who passed well is told retaking the exam is not allowed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something ruled out or refused by an official is forbidden.

clue.text: Visible discernment?

definitions.meaning: able to be seen, read as a two-word phrase meaning within view

explanation.surface: Perceptiveness you can see.
explanation.definitionFit: Two readings: split, it means within view; whole, it is perceptive understanding.

clue.text: Finish up having a drink outside for pleasure

indicators.note: the drink goes outside the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: a glass is a drink, as in a glass of wine

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: the end is the finish

explanation.surface: Wrapping up the evening with a drink for enjoyment.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' means read from bottom to top, i.e. backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: joy or happiness felt is delight.

clue.text: He's patronised by another

parts.note: patronised looks like talked down to, but here means supported by a patron or mentor

explanation.surface: A man condescended to by someone else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'patronised' suggests condescension; the sense meant is sponsored by a patron.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a person guided and helped along in a career by an influential mentor.

clue.text: Architect's plan for advancement

definitions.meaning: a drawing of one face of a building

explanation.surface: A design drawn up for getting on in life.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a scale drawing of a building's face, and promotion or raising to higher rank.

clue.text: Cook sausage to satisfy hunger?

indicators.note: to cook is to prepare, and cooking the books means falsifying, so the word's letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Frying a banger to stave off hunger.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to relieve or appease a craving such as hunger.

clue.text: Former buccaneer loses right to do penance

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: the buccaneer word gives up a letter, which is taken away

parts.note: a buccaneer is a pirate

explanation.surface: A retired pirate gives up his rights to atone for his crimes.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to make amends or atone for a sin or wrong.

clue.text: There'll be friction as long as he's at work

definitions.text: There'll be friction as long as he's at work

parts.words: There'll be friction as long as he's at work
parts.note: friction sounds like workplace conflict, but here means rubbing of the body

explanation.surface: A troublesome colleague who causes conflict whenever he is on duty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'friction' suggests quarrels; the sense meant is physical rubbing.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a man whose job is to rub and knead muscles for therapy.

clue.text: Ring fighter likely to produce a pass when charged

definitions.text: Ring fighter likely to produce a pass when charged

parts.words: Ring fighter likely to produce a pass when charged
parts.note: a ring fighter sounds like a boxer, but here the ring is a bullring and the pass is the cape swept past a charging bull

explanation.surface: A boxer who shows a pass card when arrested.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charged' suggests accused of a crime; the sense meant is attacked by a bull.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: the bullfighter who sweeps the cape past a charging bull in the arena.

clue.text: Field the Royal Navy become proficient in

parts.note: a lea is a meadow or field, a poetic word

explanation.surface: A sailor picking up skills on a parade ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to acquire a skill or knowledge through study or practice.

clue.text: Change later, or change now

indicators.note: an instruction to rearrange the letters of the neighbouring word on the spot

explanation.surface: Should I make the change later, or right away?
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to modify or make different.

clue.text: It may be parental — or not

definitions.text: It may be parental — or not

indicators.note: suggests the word could become something else, a rearrangement of its letters

explanation.surface: Something that might be to do with parents, or might not.
explanation.walkthrough: The word is a rearrangement of parental, and is parental in sense when it concerns a father, though not when concerning a mother.
explanation.definitionFit: Relation: fatherly care is one kind of parental care, so it may or may not apply.

clue.text: Draws the line at regulations

definitions.meaning: literally marks straight lines, as with a ruler

explanation.surface: Someone who refuses to go along with regulations.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: marks straight lines on paper, and official principles governing conduct.

clue.text: Canteen litter

explanation.surface: Rubbish left in a dining hall.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a forces dining hall, and disorder or untidiness.

clue.text: Show fight having provision for spectators

parts.note: with means having, as in a house with a garden
a stand is the raised seating at a sports ground

explanation.surface: A boxing promotion with seating for the crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Show fight' looks like a staged bout, but it means put up resistance.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to resist or hold out against an attack is to put up a fight.

clue.text: I will gain knowledge about French river

indicators.note: the knowledge word goes about, around, the single letter

parts.note: lore is traditional knowledge

explanation.surface: Someone resolving to learn about a river in France.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the longest river in France, flowing west past the famous châteaux.

clue.text: Patch up agreement for Russian resistance to meet knight

parts.note: da is Russian for yes
R is the symbol for electrical resistance
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A Russian treaty to end resistance and meet a knight.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to mend a hole in fabric with interwoven stitches, as with socks.

clue.text: Exhibits salesman takes exception to

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
to resent is to take offence at

explanation.surface: A salesperson objects to some displays.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to show or depict something, as a painting shows its subject.
